item.title: The Cognitive Awakening
item.description: Subtitle: The Driving Force That Initiates Self-Change Author: Zhou Ling Publisher: Posts & Telecom Press Publication Year: 2020-10 ISBN: 9787115543424 Notes: The book is divided into two parts. The first part is inward-looking: understanding yourself. Starting from the triune brain theory, it explains how the brain works. The instinctive brain maintains basic physiological needs, the emotional brain handles emotion and social interaction, and the rational brain processes logic and decision-making.

item.title: What Makes You Mediocre
item.description: 1. Lacking a Desire That Comes from Within Desire is what creates motivation. The desire to survive and the desire for something better are the wellspring that drives human progress. The stronger the desire, the stronger the motivation. An intense desire makes a person charge at the goal regardless of everything.

item.title: When We're on Ticket Duty, What Are We On Duty For?
item.description: 1. When We’re on Ticket Duty, What Are We On Duty For? Most people have probably only ever filed a ticket, never worked one. And people who have worked tickets generally don’t file them lightly. A ticket is a service bundled free with the product a customer paid for, dedicated to solving every kind of usage problem.

item.title: Engineers Need More Sense of Service
item.description: 1. About the Service Industry The primary sector, represented by agriculture, solves the problem of survival; the secondary sector, represented by industry, solves the problem of efficiency; the tertiary sector, represented by services, solves other people’s problems. Unless some factor puts people’s physical existence under threat, the service industry has extremely broad room to grow.
